text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Okay! The tent is totally perfect now. 
Now then, shall we go gather some 
firewood?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ...Still, as expected of your 
skill, Mr. Heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I head into the mountains quite a 
bit♪ It trains both the body and mind, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the idea of winter camping with 
everyone never even crossed my mind. 
Thanks for planning it, Cesario!”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! I was the one who made the plan, 
but the one who came up with the idea was—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ That's the only part I did! I just 
wanted to make memories with everyone at 
the end of our Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...I say that, but all I did was come up 
with the idea! Cesario worked super hard 
on the planning, and Messiah put so much 
effort into the prep—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally relying on Heart-san right 
now! Hehehe, I'm so glad we have this 
group~♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, truly. Well then... let's finish 
gathering firewood, cook our food, and 
enjoy camping to our hearts' content♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! The snow's piled up quite a bit! 
It's almost hard just to walk...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's true. But with this much— Fufu, we 
could make lots of Snowmen♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, snowmen!? That's awesome~!! Hey, 
let's all make some together later and 
line them up! I really wanna take a 
picture~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If we're making something, mine's 
definitely gotta be... a bunny! W-What 
about you, Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. If we deliberately leave 
out the rabbit... and go all out—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A squirrel, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Oohh...!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I've gotten completely chilled to 
the bone...! We had already planned on 
kimchi hot pot for dinner to warm 
ourselves up, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's just been playing outside in 
the snow. Maybe I should make it a bit 
spicier than planned...? I can handle 
spicy food pretty well, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I am not particularly 
skilled at it... However, I believe that 
is a wonderful suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! Then let's make this super 
spicy and hotâª

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eek!? W-Wait, wait! Go easy on me, 
pleaseee~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There, there, Craft... Hehe, don't worry, 
we'll finish with a cheese risotto to 
mellow things out. Eat lots, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Cesariooo...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a fun night for the four of us 
wore on—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Zzz……。

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...I feel wide awake for some reason. 
Maybe I should go for a short walk 
outside—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Craft-san. ...Can you not sleep?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Messiah-san! ...Wait, are we 
matching?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Indeed. I feel sort of light and 
fluffy inside.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Totally! I feel the exact same way~! Today 
was so much fun, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep making memories like this 
forever. Memories of us that will last far 
into the future—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Messiah-san. You know, I—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...I was SO, SO frustrated! Having you 
sweep the entire Triple Tiara right out 
from under me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I felt so bitter, so frustrated... And 
that's why I admired you even more. 
Carrying on your mother's feelings, 
running, and shining so brilliantly 
through it all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I felt this overwhelming 
surge of, 'I have to do this, I really, 
really want to do this!'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because I wanted to shine and leave a 
mark just like you... I'm still able to 
run today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Craft-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. And that's the end of my slightly 
embarrassing secret confession!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back to the tent? ...Maybe 
I'll snuggle up next to Messiah-san when I 
sleep tonight?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Just for tonight, okay?
